scope: Four books in their first editions (Paris: Félix Alcan): the Essai sur les données immédiates de la conscience (1889), the doctoral thesis; Matière et mémoire (1896); Le Rire (1900); and Durée et simultanéité (1922). QUEUED: L'Évolution créatrice (1907) and L'Énergie spirituelle (1919), not found in French in an open scan; La Pensée et le mouvant, whose collected form is of 1934. Not seated: Les Deux Sources de la morale et de la religion (1932), in copyright in the United States.

why_seated: MANUS, 27 October 2026, after the twenty-sixth seating: "deleuze and guattari... no way around that copyright, huh?" Told that every route through it is closed for decades, and offered a declared absence for them and the open sources they read: "yes - i cant believe we havent seated spinoza yet. yes to all" — and "and leibniz' monodology only". Bergson is seated as the source of Deleuze's Le Bergsonisme (1966) and of the durée and the virtual that run through Différence et répétition and the cinema books.
ruling: Seated in the language each wrote in, as far as the public domain of the United States reaches and an open witness was found, beside the declared absence of Deleuze and Guattari (27/07) (MANUS, 2026-10-27).
